query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS change_requests (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  business_process_id INT NOT NULL,
  user_id INT NOT NULL,
  change_request_status ENUM('pending', 'processing', 'preview', 'applied', 'rejected', 'rolled_back') DEFAULT 'pending' NOT NULL,
  request_text TEXT NOT NULL,
  request_type VARCHAR(50),
  target_step_id VARCHAR(100),
  proposed_changes TEXT,
  changes_summary TEXT,
  progress INT DEFAULT 0,
  progress_message VARCHAR(255),
  new_version_id INT,
  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  applied_at TIMESTAMP NULL,
  rolled_back_at TIMESTAMP NULL,
  FOREIGN KEY (business_process_id) REFERENCES business_processes(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS process_versions (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  business_process_id INT NOT NULL,
  version_number INT NOT NULL,
  title VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL,
  description TEXT,
  stages TEXT,
  roles TEXT,
  steps TEXT,
  branches TEXT,
  documents TEXT,
  it_integration TEXT,
  diagram_data TEXT,
  stage_details TEXT,
  total_time INT,
  total_cost INT,
  change_request_id INT,
  change_summary TEXT,
  created_by_id INT,
  is_active INT DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  FOREIGN KEY (business_process_id) REFERENCES business_processes(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  FOREIGN KEY (created_by_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
);
